meta.title: christian Football Coaching — Lake County, FL
meta.description: Professional football coaching in Clermont, FL. Training sessions for youth and high school athletes.

about.name: Coach christian
about.bio:
I am eager to learn and help other people reach their goals! I am full of energy, confident and am great at helping young/new athletes improve explosiveness, agility, form/mechanics, hand-eye-coordination, balance, stability, and confidence .

Through out My high school and college career I have battled against many severe injures such as torn ACL, Patellar tendinitis, broken wrists, broken fibula, herniated disk C7-C6 vertebrae and broken ankles. 

• Those injuries helped me learn how to properly Rehab and practice exercises and movement to prevent the injuries from happening again. 

• This adds another dimension to my skillset because I am able to help athletes rehab correctly and make sure they are doing the correct exercise to make the effected area stronger and to prevent future injuries.

hero.headline: Lake County's Premier Football Coach
hero.subline: Personalized football training that turns potential into performance.

testimonials.quote: Coach christian has a gift for breaking down the fundamentals. My kid went from nervous on the field to one of the most confident players on the team.

testimonials.quote: Nobody pushes me the right way like Coach christian does. Every session I leave better than I came.
